 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 3 15-09-2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. By order dated 11.08.2023, this matter was referred to the Patna High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre to resolve the dispute between the parties.

entities.text: Patna High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. The learned Mediator vide its report dated 12.09.2023 has, inter alia, reported that a settlement has been arrived at between the parties as per the terms and conditions as mentioned in the report.
5. The petitioner and the opposite party no. 2 are personally present in the Court.

The petitioner has given a bank Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.47439 of 2023(3) dt.15-09-2023 draft of Rs. 10 lakh to the opposite party no. 2 and the said bank draft is accepted by the opposite party in the Court.
6.

As the dispute has already been resolved between the parties, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Swaraj Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198265581/
1 Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Complaint Case No. 149(C) of 2021,
subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) anand/-
